elements.name: image
elements.brief: Share an image, with optional text, using a native sharing dialog. On
elements.description:
Share an image, with optional text, using a native sharing dialog. On
Android the image must be decodable by `BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray()`,
on iOS and macOS by `UIImage.initWithData`, and on HTML5 it may be a data
URI or any format the browser supports.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.doc: Image file name, HTML5 only. Default is `file.png`.

elements.name: file
elements.brief: Share a file, with optional text, using a native sharing dialog. The file
elements.description:
Share a file, with optional text, using a native sharing dialog. The file
keeps its original name and extension.

parameters.name: path
parameters.doc: Full path to the file to share. On HTML5, the file name. Default is `file.txt`.

parameters.name: text
parameters.doc: Optional text to share. On HTML5, the contents of the file.
